description:
Authored descriptor for a pack's identity and lineage.

Fields
------
pack_id : str
    Stable, immutable ULID (26 chars). Sole runtime identity for the pack.
    Minted once at creation; never changed. Mirrors the ``mission_id`` model.
pack_version : str
    Semantic versioning string, required at every pack level, non-empty.
parent_pack : str | None
    ULID of the parent pack, if this pack extends another. Resolved via
    identity→key adapter feeding ``extends.resolve_extends_order``.
    ``None`` for root packs. An unresolvable ``parent_pack`` (pre-backfill)
    fails closed, never silently degrades.
name : str
    Human-readable handle. No longer the identity key; used for display, in
    resolved commands and as the ``<name>::`` qualifier of a cross-pack
    reference, so it follows the identifier grammar ``^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$``.
    The resolver disambiguates with no silent fallback.
pack_level : PackTier | absent
    The declared Charter Pack tier (``built-in`` / ``org`` / ``project``),
    reusing the single :data:`kernel.pack_tiers.PackTier` authority — no new
    enum. Required when ``depends_on`` is non-empty; otherwise optional (an
    absent level is the ``pack_level_missing`` diagnostic, and the configured
    level is used). An unknown value is a schema error.
requires_core : str | None
    An optional PEP 440 version-specifier range (e.g. ``">=4.0,<5.0"``)
    naming the Spec Kitty core versions this pack supports. Validated as a
    :class:`packaging.specifiers.SpecifierSet`; an unparsable value is a
    schema error naming the field. ``None`` means no constraint.
active_charter : str | None
    An optional pack-relative path to the active-charter file
    (``org-charter.yaml`` for an org pack). A plain string here; in-pack
    path resolution (no ``..`` escape) is validated by ``charter pack
    validate`` (WP02), not at model time.
pack_drg : str | None
    An optional pack-relative path to the DRG source. A plain string here;
    in-pack path resolution is validated by ``charter pack validate``.
mutability_policy : str | absent
    An optional pack-relative path to the pack's mutability policy file, at the
    pack root (ADR-0063). This version admits only ``policy.yaml``; the key is
    kept so that a later version can widen it. The file is validated by the
    ``policy`` schema; a named file that is missing or invalid makes the pack
    unreadable. Absent, every artifact of the pack is open.
fallback_profile : str | absent
    The profile-id of the pack's declared fallback agent profile (ADR-0068). A
    pack of the declaring pack's closure holds it, locked along the closure, with
    ``role: generic`` and no alt-roles; a breach is a violation of pack.yaml (fallback_profile_unknown,
    fallback_profile_not_locked, fallback_profile_not_role_neutral).

depends_on : list | absent
    The packs this pack depends on, each by descriptor ``pack_id`` and a PEP 440
    ``range`` the held ``pack_version`` must satisfy (ADR-0048 decision 1,
    ADR-0053 decision 4). A pack that declares one must also declare
    ``pack_level``.
overrides : list | absent
    The sibling conflicts this pack settles, each by the conflicting artifact
    and the ``member`` pack meant to win (ADR-0048 decision 9, ADR-0053
    decision 5). Until #358 any pack of the compose may declare it, not only
    the distribution pack. Until #357 settling only clears the refusal; the
    member's version is not yet put in force.

The schema is closed (ADR-0036 decision 3): a key it does not declare,
a retired field such as ``accompanies_doctrine_pack`` included, makes
``pack.yaml`` unreadable.

schema_version.description: The descriptor shape's version, the string "1.0". It declares the depends_on shape and switches on ADR-0066's empty-prompt-slot check: slots in this pack's mission step prompts must hold only whitespace or are refused as prompt_slot_not_empty. An unversioned descriptor is the legacy shape; legacy text between paired slot markers remains admitted and produces a prompt_slot_not_empty warning instead.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

pack_id.description: Stable ULID identity (26 chars, Crockford base32: digits and capital letters without I, L, O and U); immutable sole runtime identity.
pack_id.title: Pack Id

pack_version.title: Pack Version
pack_version.description: Semantic version string; required at every pack level, non-null and non-empty.

parent_pack.description: Parent pack ULID (26 chars); None for root packs.
parent_pack.title: Parent Pack

name.description: Human-readable handle; not the runtime identity. It is the qualifier of a cross-pack reference (<name>::<urn>), so it follows the identifier grammar: lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter or digit.
name.title: Name

pack_level.description: Declared Charter Pack tier: built-in, org or project. Required when depends_on is non-empty; otherwise optional, and when present it is one of the three.
pack_level.title: Pack Level

depends_on.description: The packs this pack depends on, each by pack id and a PEP 440 version range (ADR-0048 decision 1, ADR-0053 decision 4). The item is closed. A pack that declares a dependency must also declare pack_level.

range.description: A PEP 440 version-specifier set the held pack version must satisfy.
range.title: Range

depends_on.title: Depends On

overrides.description: The sibling conflicts this pack settles, each by the conflicting artifact and the member pack meant to win (ADR-0048 decision 9, ADR-0053 decision 5). Until #358 any pack of the compose may declare an edge, not only the distribution pack. Until #357 settling only clears the refusal; the member's version is not yet put in force. The item is closed; an edge names exactly one winner, and a second edge on the same artifact in one descriptor is refused on read.

artifact.description: The conflicting artifact's URN, kept opaque here; it must resolve inside the compose.
artifact.title: Artifact

member.description: The pack_id (ULID, 26 characters) of the member whose version wins; it must be in the compose.
member.title: Member

overrides.title: Overrides

requires_core.description: Optional PEP 440 version-specifier range of supported core versions.
requires_core.title: Requires Core

active_charter.description: Optional pack-relative path to the active-charter file.
active_charter.title: Active Charter

pack_drg.description: Optional pack-relative path to the DRG source.
pack_drg.title: Pack Drg

mutability_policy.description: Optional pack-relative path to the pack's mutability policy file (ADR-0063). Only policy.yaml, at the pack root, is admitted in this version; a named file that is missing or invalid makes the pack unreadable.
mutability_policy.title: Mutability Policy

fallback_profile.description: The profile-id of the agent profile this pack declares as its fallback (ADR-0068): the profile selection returns, marked as a fallback, when no profile fits the role a step asks for. A pack of the pack's closure must hold the profile, locked along the closure, with `role: generic` and no alt-roles. Optional; never null.
fallback_profile.title: Fallback Profile

title: PackDescriptor

Ulid.description: A ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32 (digits and capital letters without I, L, O and U).
Ulid.title: Ulid
